J U D G M E N T
KURIAN, J.
1.
Leave granted.
2.
The issue raised in this appeal is whether The
Securitisation and Reconstruction of Financial Assets
and Enforcement of Security Interest Act (SARFAESI)
is applicable in the State of Jammu and Kashmir.
3.
That question has been answered by this Court in
detail in  State Bank of India Vs. Santosh Gupta and
Anr. Etc., reported in (2017) 2 SCC 538.  It has been
held by this Court that the Act is applicable in the
State of Jammu and Kashmir.  Therefore, the Judgment
of the High Court is set aside and this appeal is
allowed.
